title: Backups and Recovery
meta: Regular backups and a tested way to restore them, so a mistake or outage is a small problem. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Backups and recovery you have actually tested
overview: A backup nobody has tested is only a hope. We work out what you need to protect, set up automatic backups for your files, databases and settings, store copies in a second place and then do a real restore to prove it works. You get a one-page recovery guide that says who does what, in what order, so a bad day is handled calmly.

pkgs.blurb: Automatic daily backups for one system, with a restore check.
Copies kept in a second location, with alerts when backups fail.
A full recovery plan with timing targets and a practice run.
list: Test reminder set up each quarter

faq: Databases, uploaded files, configuration and, where needed, whole servers. We list everything with you first, because the common mistake is backing up the database and forgetting uploads or settings.
Daily by default. Busy databases can be backed up more often or continuously with point-in-time restore, which we can add. We choose with you based on how much data you could afford to lose.
In your own cloud account, in a separate location from the live system, and encrypted. From Standard up, a second storage location protects you against a whole region failing.
Do you restore the data if something goes wrong later?
The package covers set-up and tests. If you need us for a real recovery later, we can help under a new order. Your recovery guide lets your own team do it too.
